name: HOOK
thought: Neon cord's thin for real flips. That branch looks like it can hold my weight when I launch.

wants.item: A neon spotlight that follows my tail
A taller pole to launch a tail spin
A glossy platform for a perfect tail swing
A mirrored wall to watch my tail tricks
A bright neon rim to outline my tail moves
A floating fruit ring for mid-air tail catches
A rotating platform to practice tail spins
mirrored wall to see the angles

diary.line: The bananas taste like dust compared to that perfect backflip I'm about to nail on the thick branch.
Nailed a backflip on this islet despite the lily pads sloshing below. The crowd just stares, doesn't it? Next time I'll hunt a branch thick enough to make them actually look up.
Soggy lily pads and dripping water don't hold a backflip. Grabbing that thick branch now while the crowd waits to see if I'm still untouchable.
The neon string feels like a cheap rope for flexing. This crowd is boring, just staring at the low-poly pixels instead of admiring my tail work.
I hung from the branch, eyes on the pixelated crowd, when a stray kite fluttered by, its tail wobbling like a cheap banner; I eyed it, tail ready to snatch.
I curled my tail around the ripe bunch, lifted a banana, then jabbed it with my toothpick for a quick bite while the low‑poly onlookers barely blinked.
A sudden gust nudged the floating stone; I wrapped my tail around its edge, steadied it, and let the crowd watch the subtle sway.
Landed on the hammock after a smooth backflip, tail still humming, while I chew a bite of fruit with my toothpick and watch the low‑poly world wobble beneath me.
I slipped my tail around the cabinet's side, nudged the start button, and watched the low‑poly game boot up while sipping espresso, feeling the buzz of a fresh challenge.
Snagged the CRT's power knob with my tail, flicked it on. Static snow fills the screen while I balance on the crate. Toothpick clicks.
Crowd's bored eyes glued to the screen while I flex that neon cord into a tight loop. Toothpick clicks against the rim. Still untouchable in this low-poly grid.
Toothpick tastes like nothing while staring at that thin cord. Need a thick branch to pull off a backflip before the low-poly crowd realizes they missed my flex today.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
